card.name: Shaking or patting off liquid
card.fires_on: Words in instructions for removing moisture, such as 'pat' in 'pat dry', 'excess' after 'shake off', or 'blot' dry. They come right before 'dry' or 'solution'.

modes.label: Pat or blot dry
modes.description: The word 'pat' (or 'patted', 'blot') in skin or wound care steps after rinsing.
modes.example: rinse thoroughly and<< pat>> dry. Rinsing with plain water
